description.value: JJ Bean Coffee Roasters is Vancouver's favourite independent specialty coffee chain, founded in 1996 by the Neate family, with a philosophy of honouring people through carefully sourced and small-batch roasted coffee, in-house daily baking, and neighbourhood-specific café designs. The Yaletown location on Davie Street is one of multiple Metro Vancouver cafés, each designed to reflect its surrounding community. Cyclists stopping here will find espresso drinks, single-origin coffees, freshly baked goods, and an all-day breakfast and lunch menu made entirely in-house.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: stands (3 spaces) at 69m; stands (3 spaces) at 75m; stands (3 spaces) at 96m. Total: 9 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms JJ Bean is an active multi-location Vancouver specialty coffee roaster with indoor/outdoor seating and daily food service; the OSM email yaletown@jjbeancoffee.com identifies this node as the Yaletown café at 402 Davie Street. The website's contact page lists 1904 Powell Street (the roastery/HQ) rather than 402 Davie, and a different phone number, but these are corporate details for a different location rather than contradictions of the café record. Bike infrastructure, washrooms, Wi-Fi, and most other WWC amenities are unmentioned on both OSM and the fetched website content.
concerns: Website contact page lists the roastery/HQ address (1904 Powell Street, V5L 1J3) rather than the Yaletown café address (402 Davie Street, V6B 2G3); these are distinct locations so the OSM café address cannot be directly corroborated from website content.
Website contact phone (604-254-0161 / 1-877-433-3723) differs from OSM phone (+1-604-684-9253); the website numbers appear to be roastery/HQ lines, not the specific Yaletown café number.

Fetched website is a corporate brand site covering all locations; per-location amenity details such as washrooms, bike parking, Wi-Fi, and dietary options are not listed and could not be verified from available content.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: JJ Bean is a well-established, actively operating Vancouver café with indoor and outdoor seating and full food service, making it a solid rest stop for touring cyclists in Yaletown; several WWC criteria remain unconfirmed but no disqualifying issues are present.

wow_evidence: Vancouver's favourite independent specialty coffee chain... multiple Metro Vancouver cafés
